candidates.hook: CLARISSA: 'I want to see you crawl, sister.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana accepts the sadistic trial, declaring 'Tell me where the garden is,' right before risking her hands on the razor briars.
candidates.why: It delivers a cruel villain hook, sets up horrific stakes with razor thorns vs. the gallows, and ends on a sacrificial heroism beat.

candidates.hook: CLARISSA: 'Oh, dear sister... still defending your broken scrap of a man?'
candidates.cliffhanger: Clarissa whispers 'Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows,' cutting right on the life-or-death ultimatum.
candidates.why: Starts with a vicious character insult and builds up to an unhinged gallows ultimatum cut right at the peak of terror.

candidates.hook: CONSTABLE: 'Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Clarissa turns with a predatory smile and says 'I want to see you crawl, sister,' cutting before revealing her twisted demand.
candidates.why: Establishes immediate legal jeopardy and wife intervention before teasing a sinister villain revenge plot.

moments.desc: The Constable attempts to handcuff Alexander for theft, but Juliana heroically steps in front of him.
Clarissa demands Juliana crawl and retrieve her signet ring from frozen, steel-sharp briars.
Clarissa whispers into Juliana's ear that if she fails or refuses, Alexander will hang on the gallows.
